name: Feature::Ui
guard: Inline hook on the `bl` to the allocator inside the UI holder constructor (`main+0x3773770`), after the layout archive was decompressed: x21 is the decompressed bytes, x1, x23 and x24 their size (`mov x1, x24` precedes the call). The hook replaces x21 with the plugin's archive and the three size registers with its size; the game then allocates that size and copies from x21 (SPEC-core-05 §4.1). Only the `info_training` archive is replaced.

name: Feature::Ui

name: Feature::Ui
guard: Inline anchor inside the UI manager's insert (`main+0x37849c0`), before the initial Calculate of a newly registered holder (x21): the registration tick, on the main thread (SPEC-core-05 §4.1).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: Relied-on `adrp x28, ...; ldr x8, [x28, #0xa90]` in the UI manager's per-frame pass: the plugin decodes the manager's global slot (`main+0x593ba90`) from these two words (position independent) and never writes it. The pass's own entry words are not relied on: another plugin may have hooked them (SPEC-core-05 §6).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: The game's pane text setter `(pane, text, units, flags)`, called never hooked (other plugins' hooks anywhere in its bytes are fine): it grows the text box's buffer to fit, then sets the text, so the plugin never sizes a game buffer itself. The same function the CPU pilot and gsp-visualizer call.
